video_title: How the NBA's esports league reinvented itself as a creator-led media company

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA 2K is the most popular basketball video game in the world
quotes.excerpt: 2K Studios, which is a studio inside of T2, makes NBA 2K, which is the most popular basketball video game in the world.
quotes.quote: 2K Studios, which is a studio inside of T2, makes NBA 2K, which is the most popular basketball video game in the world.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA 2K licensing is a deal between the league and the publisher
quotes.excerpt: Any video game that uses a sports league's IP is a licensing deal between that league and the video game publisher.
quotes.quote: Any video game that uses a sports league's IP is a licensing deal between that league and the video game publisher. The NBA and 2K have a long-standing, very productive and creative relationship that has enabled the video game NBA 2K to grow into a really fascinating, multi-faceted, interactive ecosystem.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA 2K League was formed as a joint venture with Take-Two
quotes.excerpt: The joint venture was originally formed to build and run the NBA's esports league.
quotes.quote: The joint venture was originally formed to build and run the NBA's esports league. This was in the 2016-2017 range when the energy for esports was at an all-time high. The NBA wanted to become the first pro sports league to build an esports league. In collaboration with Take-Two in a new joint venture that would be 50-50 jointly owned, they would build an esports league using the 30 NBA teams that the NBA already had.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: The goal was for the best 2K gamers to represent NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: The idea was the very best 2K gamers in the world would represent NBA teams and play for the championship of 2K.
quotes.quote: The idea was the very best 2K gamers in the world would represent NBA teams and play for the championship of 2K.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: Esports leagues failed by applying a traditional pro sports model to gaming
quotes.excerpt: Many esports leagues simply tried to apply the same in real life pro sports model to gaming.
quotes.quote: Many esports leagues simply tried to apply the same in real life pro sports model to gaming. Bring people to arenas, sell broadcast rights, sell sponsorship. That should be the base of a big business. Simply cutting and pasting the model from a different type of sport was not the right way to go about building esports.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: League of Legends is well-suited for a hardcore esports league
quotes.excerpt: League of Legends is actually very well-suited for a hardcore esports league.
quotes.quote: League of Legends is actually very well-suited for a hardcore esports league. Everyone who plays League of Legends wants to become the best version of his or her archetype. Outside of watching the very best League of Legends players do amazing things with their characters, there's no other place to see that. League of Legends is actually very well-suited for a hardcore esports league.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: 2K players are as interested in basketball culture as they are in competing
quotes.excerpt: People who play 2K are just as interested in basketball culture as they are in competing at 2K.
quotes.quote: People who play 2K are just as interested in basketball culture as they are in competing at 2K. They're talking about which rookies look good in preseason. They're excited about the next movie that is dropping or Drake's new album. The culture around basketball is just as important to them, and the hang is just as important as competing.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: The goal of the 2K League is to build a set of programs and experiences
quotes.excerpt: The goal is for the 2K League to be a set of programs and experiences that pull NBA players, creators, fans, elite 2K gamers together.
quotes.quote: The goal is for the 2K League to be a set of programs and experiences that pull NBA players, creators, fans, elite 2K gamers together in a really fun, competitive world that has 2K at the center of it.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA 2K players are humanized by their personalities on social media
quotes.excerpt: It brings out who they really are, it humanizes them in the same way that the Hot Ones and Hot Ones humanizes celebrities.
quotes.quote: It brings out who they really are, it humanizes them in the same way that the Hot Ones and Hot Ones humanizes celebrities.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Polmutter
quotes.summary_phrase: The goal is to make the 2K League a membership community
quotes.excerpt: We aim to make the way we engage 2K users more of a membership community than just a set of games to participate in.
quotes.quote: We aim to make the way we engage 2K users more of a membership community than just a set of games to participate in. And that community should become a business unto itself with an infrastructure for itself.
